createGuild.title: Create Your Server
createGuild.subtitle: Your server is where you and your friends can hang out, share voice, video, and ideas.
createGuild.randomIconTip: Click the star in the bottom right corner for a random icon
createGuild.isPublicTitle: Make this server public in Discovery
createGuild.isPublicDesc: Allow others to find and join directly from the public discovery hall
createGuild.haveInvite: Already have an invite link? Join here

joinGuild.title: Join a Server
joinGuild.subtitle: Enter an invite link or invite code to join an existing server.
joinGuild.noInvite: Don't have an invite code? Create a server

createChannel.title: Create Channel
createChannel.subtitle: Establish a new channel for communication in this server.
createChannel.textTypeDesc: Post messages, images, emojis, code snippets, and files
createChannel.voiceTypeDesc: Real-time voice calls, low-latency screen sharing, and video
createChannel.topicPlaceholder: Let everyone know what this channel is about...
createChannel.e2eeDesc: Client-side encrypted, plaintext is not stored on the server

editChannel.title: Channel Settings
editChannel.subtitle: Configure channel #{{name}} name, topic, and security settings
editChannel.topicPlaceholder: Let everyone know what this channel is about
editChannel.deleteConfirmDesc: Are you sure you want to delete #{{name}}? This cannot be undone and all message history will be permanently deleted.
editChannel.deleteWarning: All messages and media in this channel will be permanently removed upon deletion.

createCategory.title: Create Category
createCategory.subtitle: Create a new channel category to organize text and voice channels.

editCategory.title: Edit Category
editCategory.subtitle: Modify category name or manage its settings.
editCategory.deleteConfirmDesc: Are you sure you want to delete category "{{name}}"? Channels within will be moved to uncategorized.
editCategory.deleteWarning: Channels within this category will be preserved and moved to the uncategorized area without losing data.

discovery.title: Discover Public Servers
discovery.subtitle: Find amazing communities and real-time audio/video spaces on Tescord
discovery.noGuildsDesc: Try a different search term, or create your own server.
discovery.invitePrompt: Enter the 8-character invite code provided by an admin or friend.
discovery.noMatchingCircles: Haven't found what you're looking for?

screenShare.title: Screen & Window Sharing (LiveKit Simulcast)
screenShare.subtitle: Select a screen or window to stream to everyone in this channel
screenShare.browserDirectDesc: Clicking 'Go Live' will prompt the browser native screen selection. Use the Tescord Electron Desktop client for lower latency and exclusive game audio capture.
screenShare.sfuModeDesc: Intelligently distributed by central media server, supports hundreds of viewers, adaptive quality
screenShare.p2pModeDesc: Viewers establish direct P2P connections with the streamer, eliminating server bandwidth load
screenShare.p2pMesh: Streamer Serves All (Mesh Direct, Zero Relay Latency)
screenShare.audioMixDesc: Mix and broadcast system game audio with microphone audio on the client
screenShare.browserAudioTip: 💡 Tip: If audio is unavailable, it will fall back to video only. Sharing your screen or a Chrome tab is recommended for audio.
screenShare.webrtcEngine: Ultra Low Latency WebRTC Media Engine
screenShare.permissionDenied: Unable to obtain screen share permission

p2pFallback.title: Media Routing Downgraded
p2pFallback.desc: LiveKit SFU is temporarily unavailable. The call has seamlessly downgraded to WebRTC P2P mesh mode. Audio/video quality may vary based on NAT traversal.
p2pFallback.failedToConnect: Failed to establish direct P2P connection with {{streamOwnerName}}:
p2pFallback.descFallback: To keep the stream running smoothly, you can switch to Server Relay (LiveKit SFU) mode. Server relay provides fast adaptive distribution.

forcedPasswordChange.title: Set New Login Password
forcedPasswordChange.subtitle: The temporary password generated by administrator can only be used for this login. All devices will need to sign in again after updating.
forcedPasswordChange.passwordLengthError: New password must be at least 10 characters and match the confirmation
